name: Subscription / Recurring Option
summary: Named purchase-options fieldset containing one optional one-time purchase and one canonical Radio for every eligible recurring allocation, with explicit checkout charge, per-delivery amount, cadence, verified savings, and selected inline terms.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Canonical native Fieldset and complete purchase-options group.

anatomy.name: legend
anatomy.description: First visible Legend naming the purchase decision.

anatomy.name: choices
anatomy.description: Ordered composition containing at least two valid purchase choices.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: One quiet bordered one-time or recurring purchase choice; it is layout, not a second control.

anatomy.name: choice
anatomy.description: Canonical Radio whose native input owns the option value and checkedness.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Visible localized label that names one concrete purchase choice.

anatomy.name: summary
anatomy.description: Always-visible checkout-price and optional savings description associated with the Radio.

anatomy.name: priceLabel
anatomy.description: Visible localized text distinguishing one-time price, checkout charge, and per-delivery amount.

anatomy.name: checkoutPrice
anatomy.description: Canonical Price with an explicit localized one-time-price or checkout-charge label.

anatomy.name: savings
anatomy.description: Optional passive canonical Badge containing only a verified localized target calculation.

anatomy.name: recurring
anatomy.description: Required always-visible per-delivery price and cadence description for every recurring record.

anatomy.name: deliveryPrice
anatomy.description: Canonical Price with an explicit localized per-delivery label.

anatomy.name: cadence
anatomy.description: Readable localized cadence for one recurring record.

anatomy.name: details
anatomy.description: Selected-only inline detail region; it contains no second purchase-plan selector.

anatomy.name: terms

variants.name: default
variants.description: One stacked choice list with quiet boundaries and a stronger selected boundary.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One intrinsic container-responsive size; choice metadata wraps from available inline space.

states.name: unselected
states.description: No valid option is currently selected, permitted for a required subscription-only group awaiting user choice or after target stale-value repair.

states.name: selected
states.description: One one-time or concrete recurring allocation is selected; a selected recurring record exposes its optional terms inline.

states.name: hover
states.description: An available choice receives a stronger boundary without turning the complete card into a second action.

states.name: focusVisible
states.description: Canonical Radio owns the visible keyboard focus ring.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Native Fieldset disabling propagates to every contained Radio and excludes the group from submission.

states.name: withSavings
states.description: At least one recurring record includes a verified localized savings statement.

states.name: withTerms
states.description: The selected record exposes target-authored terms inline.

behavior.name: nativeChoiceGroup
behavior.description: Fieldset, Legend, and same-name native Radios own grouping, naming, mutual exclusion, keyboard behavior, validity, FormData, events, and reset without a redundant ARIA Radio implementation.

behavior.name: optionRecords
behavior.description: Ordered target records have a unique stable id, oneTime or recurring kind, visible label, and target-formatted checkout price. Recurring records additionally require target-formatted per-delivery price and readable cadence; savings, terms, and per-option disabled state are optional.

behavior.name: minimumMeaningfulSet
behavior.description: Omit the complete component when fewer than two valid choices remain. At most one one-time record is allowed; subscription-only merchandise therefore requires at least two recurring choices or a simpler non-Radio presentation.

behavior.name: defaultSelection
behavior.description: When a one-time record exists, the target initializes its Radio as selected. Subscription-only initial selection remains target policy and may begin unselected under native required validation.

behavior.name: selectionOwnership
attributes: checked establishes static or uncontrolled initial state
one controlled selectedValue in framework adapters
behavior.description: One group value is the only selection owner. Unknown or stale values resolve to no checked Radio rather than silently selecting a different plan; the product coordinator clears or replaces stale selection.

behavior.name: explicitRecurringCopy
behavior.description: Every recurring choice visibly and accessibly identifies checkout charge, per-delivery amount, and cadence even when the two monetary values happen to match.

behavior.name: selectedInlineTerms
behavior.description: Optional terms are rendered inline only for the checked record through CSS derived from native checkedness; unchecked detail is display-none and unavailable to focus.

behavior.name: canonicalComposition
behavior.description: Fieldset owns grouping, Radio owns selection, Price owns target-formatted amount anatomy, and passive Badge owns verified savings presentation. D10 contains no nested Select or private child clones.

behavior.name: targetCoordinator
behavior.description: The target product coordinator owns selling-plan groups, current product and variant, allocation eligibility, ordering, localized values, savings truth, terms, selected value, stale clearing, final target payload, loading and error policy, status announcements, cart, and checkout.

behavior.name: noNeutralRuntime
behavior.description: D10 adds no listener, observer, timer, request, formatter, storage, cart service, layout read, or component-specific neutral JavaScript; native Web and target adapters project their own data and state.

properties.name: legend
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete group when its visible purchase-decision label is empty.
properties.description: Visible localized Legend naming the complete purchase-options group.

properties.name: description
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the description and aria-describedby reference together.

properties.name: name
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete group when its native field name is empty.
properties.description: Native form name repeated across every Radio choice.

properties.name: options
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete group when fewer than two valid target option records remain.
properties.description: Ordered target option records. Each has unique id, kind, label and checkoutPrice; recurring records also require perDeliveryPrice and cadence, with optional verified savings, target-authored terms, disabled state, and one static or uncontrolled initial checked/defaultChecked projection. Controlled adapters derive checkedness from one group selectedValue.

properties.name: oneTimePriceLabel
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the component when a localized one-time amount label cannot be supplied.
properties.description: Visible localized label placed before the one-time purchase amount.

properties.name: checkoutChargeLabel

properties.description: Visible localized label placed before every recurring checkout charge.

properties.name: perDeliveryLabel
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the component when recurring per-delivery amounts cannot be explicitly labelled.
properties.description: Visible localized label placed before every recurring per-delivery amount.

properties.name: cadenceLabel

properties.description: Localized label placed before every recurring cadence value.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Requires one selected purchase option through the same-name native Radio group.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disables the complete purchase-options group through its native Fieldset.

accessibility: Use the canonical native Fieldset and first visible Legend with at least two same-name native Radios; do not add redundant radiogroup or radio roles.

Give every option a unique stable value and visible localized label. Associate its always-visible checkout, per-delivery, cadence, and savings text through aria-describedby without replacing the concise Radio name.
Keep one native checkedness owner and preserve Tab, logical arrow keys, Space, mutual exclusion, required validity, FormData, input/change, reset, and disabled propagation.
Select one-time initially whenever it exists. Never silently project an unknown or stale target id to a different plan; allow required validation while the coordinator repairs it.
Render every recurring checkout charge, per-delivery amount, and cadence as explicit readable text. Do not depend on equal prices, visual proximity, abbreviation, color, or Badge alone.
Render savings only from a verified localized target calculation. Keep Badge passive and avoid live-region semantics on static prices or terms.
Keep selected terms inline and readable; unchecked terms are display-none rather than hidden only by opacity or color.
Preserve logical wrapping, canonical Radio focus, effective 200 percent text, user text spacing, RTL, dark mode, reduced motion, forced colors, and narrow containers.

web.notes: Canonical Fieldset, Radio, Price and optional Badge composition is implemented with zero D10 neutral runtime; target records and live group state remain consumer-owned.

shopify.notes: Shopify can map variant sellingPlanAllocations to recurring records and one-time to an empty selling_plan payload, but target-native Liquid/block composition, one coordinator, localization, editor behavior and live-store proof remain required.

react.notes: The shared Exhibit and Studio artwork projects one selectedValue and repeated target records into canonical native controls. A distributable adapter may additionally expose defaultValue for uncontrolled use.
